secrets.name: JWT_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret key for signing JWT auth tokens. Auto-generated for development; set a real value for stable sessions across restarts.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL. Optional — without it the backend runs on in-memory storage (ALLOW_MEMORY_DB=true).

secrets.name: SUPABASE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase anon public key. Optional — paired with SUPABASE_URL for persistent storage.
